name: AXXES.work
description: Documents, spreadsheets and presentations in one workspace.
outcome: Turn a rough idea into a proposal, a budget and a presentation.
tagline: Documents, spreadsheets and slides in your browser
seoTitle: AXXES.work: online documents, spreadsheets and slides
metaDescription: Write documents, build spreadsheets and present slides in your browser with AXXES.work. Export to .xlsx and .pptx, and keep every file in Folders.
intro: AXXES.work is the AXXES office suite. Write documents, work through numbers in a spreadsheet and build a presentation without installing anything. Your files keep the format you opened them in.
capabilities: Documents with a block editor for proposals, briefs and notes
Spreadsheets with an A1 grid, a formula bar and common functions
Export spreadsheets to .xlsx and presentations to .pptx
Slides with layouts, speaker notes and a present mode
Files stored alongside the rest of your work in Folders
goodFor: Anyone who wants an office suite in the browser

name: Folders
description: Organize files and digital assets for the people who need them.
outcome: Keep project files together instead of scattered across inboxes.
seoTitle: Folders: file storage, sharing and digital asset management
metaDescription: Folders stores, organizes and shares your files and digital assets with role-based access. Files from every AXXES app land in one place.
intro: Folders is where files live on AXXES. Upload documents, photos and media, organize them into folders and tags, and decide who can see or change each one. Files created in other AXXES apps show up here too, with a link back to where they came from.
capabilities: Upload and organize files and digital assets in folders
Tag files so they are easy to find later
Share with roles: owners, admins and managers edit, members upload, viewers read
Open a file in the AXXES app it belongs to
Files from AXXES.work, Vibez and other apps collected in one library
goodFor: Creative work with lots of media
Keeping personal and family records together

name: Lanes
description: Project boards for organizing work and its next steps.
outcome: Move a project from an idea to a clear sequence of tasks.
seoTitle: Lanes: kanban boards, sprints and project tracking
metaDescription: Lanes gives teams kanban, list and table boards, sprints, scrum poker and flow insights like lead time and WIP, with a REST API and webhooks.
intro: Lanes is project management for teams that want to see the work. Plan on a kanban board, a list or a table, run sprints, estimate together and watch how work flows through the team.
capabilities: Kanban, list and table views of the same board
Board templates to start a project quickly
Sprints and scrum poker for planning together
Insights on throughput, lead time, work in progress and aging
A REST API with tokens and webhooks

name: Relay
outcome: Give a project a place for questions, updates and decisions.
tagline: Team chat that stays with the work
seoTitle: Relay: team chat with spaces and rooms
metaDescription: Relay is team chat on AXXES. Organize conversations into spaces and rooms so questions, updates and decisions stay next to the work.
intro: Relay is where a team talks. Group conversations into spaces and rooms for each team or project, so the discussion stays close to the work it is about.
capabilities: Spaces and rooms for teams and projects
Real-time messages
Signs in with your AXXES account
goodFor: Teams that want chat next to their projects
Small companies replacing scattered group chats

name: Nexus
description: Knowledge spaces and pages for the things a team needs to remember.
outcome: Build a shared handbook for a process, a project or a team.
tagline: What your team knows, written down once
seoTitle: Nexus: team wiki and knowledge base
metaDescription: Nexus is a team wiki: spaces, nested pages, wiki links with backlinks, version history and fast search. Write it down once and find it again.
intro: Nexus is a knowledge base for teams. Write handbooks, processes and project notes in spaces of nested pages, link them together and find anything with a keystroke.
capabilities: Spaces with nested pages
Wiki links between pages, with backlinks
Version history on every page
Search everything with ⌘K
Install it as an app on your device
goodFor: Project notes that outlive the project

name: Atelier
description: Build and manage websites with AXXES.
outcome: Give a business, project or idea a home on the web.
tagline: Design, publish and manage your website
seoTitle: Atelier: website builder and CMS with free and custom domains
metaDescription: Design and publish a website with Atelier, the AXXES website builder and CMS. Start on a free name.axxes.app address or connect your own domain.
intro: Atelier is the AXXES website studio. Design pages from ready-made blocks, manage the content yourself and publish on a free axxes.app address or your own domain.
capabilities: Design pages from vetted, ready-made blocks
Manage your site's content without a developer
Publish on a free name.axxes.app address
Connect your own custom domain
Collect form submissions and see traffic with Pulse
goodFor: Small businesses that need a site

name: Pulse
description: Analytics for understanding activity across your digital work.
outcome: Turn activity into a clearer picture of what people use.
tagline: Live vital signs for your organization
seoTitle: Pulse: website and app analytics with consent controls
metaDescription: Pulse is web and app analytics with consent controls. See traffic and conversions across your sites and apps. Try it free for 30 days.
intro: Pulse shows what is happening across your websites and apps. Add it to a site or app, respect your visitors' consent choices and see traffic and conversions in reports for your organization.
capabilities: Traffic and conversion reports for your sites and apps
Consent controls for your visitors
A JavaScript SDK and setup recipes
Built into Atelier sites
30-day free trial
goodFor: Site owners who want simple analytics

name: Tollbooth
description: Payment collection for your own customers: links, checkout and payouts.
outcome: Build a payment flow for your business; merchant activation requires onboarding.
seoTitle: Tollbooth: payment links, online checkout and payouts
metaDescription: Take payments with Tollbooth: payment links, hosted checkout, a payments API with test keys and signed webhooks, and payouts to your bank.
intro: Tollbooth lets a business get paid online. Send a payment link or a hosted checkout page, follow every payment in one dashboard and receive payouts to your bank. Developers get an API, test keys and webhooks.
capabilities: Payment links and hosted checkout pages
A dashboard for payments, refunds, customers and products
Payouts to your bank account
A REST API with live and test keys and idempotent requests
Signed webhooks with a delivery log
goodFor: Developers adding payments to an app

name: AXXES.dev
description: The developer home for documentation, app credentials and API usage.
outcome: Connect your own software to AXXES services.
tagline: The whole company, as an API
seoTitle: AXXES.dev: developer portal, API reference and guides
metaDescription: AXXES.dev is the developer portal for AXXES: API reference, quickstart, guides, plan limits and changelog for connecting your software.
intro: AXXES.dev is where developers start. Read the API reference, follow the quickstart and guides, and see the limits of each plan before you connect your software to AXXES.
capabilities: API reference for AXXES services
Quickstart and guides
Plan limits and a changelog
Review and revoke personal tokens

name: AXXES API
description: The service gateway behind AXXES integrations. Explore it through the developer platform.
outcome: Build an integration around documented AXXES capabilities.
seoTitle: AXXES API: integrate your software with AXXES
metaDescription: The AXXES API is the gateway behind AXXES integrations. Explore it through AXXES.dev and build on documented capabilities.
intro: The AXXES API is the gateway your software talks to. Start from the documentation on AXXES.dev and build integrations on the capabilities that are documented there.
capabilities: An HTTP API behind AXXES integrations
Documentation and examples on AXXES.dev

name: afters.am
description: An events brand for tickets, guest lists and the door.
outcome: Bring an event from its first invitation to admission at the venue.
tagline: Sell the night, run the door
seoTitle: afters.am: event ticketing, guest lists and door scanning
metaDescription: afters.am is event ticketing for nights out: sell tickets, manage guest lists and scan at the door, with Vibez photo walls built in.
intro: afters.am is ticketing for events and nights out. Publish an event, sell tickets, manage the guest list and check people in at the door from your phone.
capabilities: Event pages and ticket sales
Guest lists
Door scanning at the venue
Vibez guest photo walls built in

name: Vibez
description: QR-powered event photos, guest cameras and shared feeds.
outcome: Let guests contribute to a shared view of an event.
seoTitle: Vibez: QR event photo booth and live photo wall
metaDescription: Turn any room into a photobooth with Vibez. Guests scan a QR code, take photos without an account and see them on a live feed and TV wall.
intro: Vibez turns an event into a shared photo album. Print QR codes around the room; guests scan one, take photos from their phone without creating an account and watch them appear on a live feed and a TV wall.
capabilities: QR spots guests scan to start shooting
No account needed for guests
Live photo feed and TV wall
Moderation, reports and bans for organizers
Every photo also saved to Folders

name: Qortr
description: A booking product for rooms and spaces.
outcome: Make a space discoverable and organize its bookings.
seoTitle: Qortr: room and space booking with floor maps
metaDescription: Qortr is room and venue booking software: interactive floor maps, flexible pricing and bookings for rooms, desks and event spaces.
intro: Qortr helps people find and book a space. Put your rooms on an interactive floor map, set flexible pricing and manage every booking in one place.
capabilities: Spaces and rooms on interactive floor maps
Flexible pricing
Online bookings
goodFor: Anyone renting rooms by the hour
